title: Best practice to format an attribute (price) on the fly
body:
I have a `price` attribute in my algolia index, that is formatted in pences (cents). When I retrieve it, I want it to be formatted in pounds, that is to say divided by 100. Using **Laravel**, **instantsearch 2.6** and **geoSearch widget** ``` var map = instantsearch.widgets.geoSearch({ container: '#map', googleReference: window.google, customHTMLMarker: { template: '
@{{price}}
', } }); ``` The `@` is because I am using Laravel I know those possible options:
  • Create a new column in the database `price_formatted`
  • Use `instantsearch.widgets.hits` to `transformData` - but I don't want to add a widget just for that
  • Use a handlebar helper - but I have really few clue on how to implement that despite my research
What would be the best practice / least resource-consuming to display my price in pounds?
